layers.source: load_tensors: layer N assigned to device — primary dense-residency signal (deduped by layer index)

residency.classification_rule: PRIMARY: layers.cpu_count > 0 -> partial-offload (dense-layer). SECONDARY: host.model_mib > 600 -> partial-offload (expert / MoE). TERTIARY (advisory): host.context_mib > 0 or host.compute_mib > 100 corroborates. Big-vocab boundary compute can false-positive on compute>100 alone, which is why the compute-only signal is tertiary.
